title: Recipe 09 — Voice Agent (realtime audio is a different harness)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Recipe 09 is the one target that does not use Claude as its spine: realtime audio in, realtime audio out, over OpenAI's Realtime API.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed recipe is never touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env. For this recipe the credential that matters is OPENAI_API_KEY, not the Anthropic one.

verify.note: operator-supplied demos/.env; the voice target talks to the OpenAI Realtime API

groups.title: Beat 1 · The spec — sixteen lines of realtime

beats.label: Name it, pick the shape
beats.cue: “target: voice” — an event-driven daemon, not a turn-driven loop.

beats.label: Add the agent block
beats.cue: “The model has to be realtime-capable. And keep the instructions short: every word is spoken out loud at conversational pace.”

beats.label: Add the voice block
beats.cue: “Provider, TTS voice, server-side VAD — and the barge-in hysteresis: four frames of speech inside 200 milliseconds cuts the agent off mid-word.”

beats.label: Close it out
beats.cue: “Tool calls inside a voice session hit the same policy engine as every other shape. The surface changed; the permission floor did not.”

beats.label: Lint the spec
beats.cue: “Parse plus the IR passes the compile path skips — nothing emitted yet.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “Twenty-four lines: provider, voiceId, vad mode, the two barge-in numbers. That is the entire realtime contract.”

verify.note: prints the IR for target voice (24 lines)

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check asserts the shape, installs the deps and boots it: GREEN, and the gate it stops at is the PCM fixture, not a credential.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok (3 anchors); install ok; boot gated at the --smoke pcm fixture gate

beats.label: Open the emitted daemon
beats.cue: “Four files came out of a sixteen-line spec, because realtime needs a process, not a function.”

beats.label: Open the voice loop
beats.cue: “VAD events in, frames out, and the barge-in counter in between. This is the part that cannot be a request/response.”

beats.label: Boot the daemon with no fixture
beats.cue: “Deliberate non-zero, exit 2: v0 ships the headless smoke path only — the WebRTC and telephony bridge is a follow-up, and the daemon says so instead of pretending.”

beats.label: Make a one-second fixture
beats.cue: “PCM 16-bit mono at 24 kHz is what every provider normalizes to — 48,000 bytes is exactly one second of it.”

verify.note: one second of silence in the canonical format

beats.label: Feed it the fixture, key scrubbed
beats.cue: “The fixture loads — 24,000 samples, one second, framed and ready — and then it stops at the credentials gate. Exit 1, and the audio path is proved without spending a cent.”

verify.note: measured exit 1: emits smoke_start and smoke_pcm_loaded (24000 samples), then `OpenAI Realtime adapter: OPENAI_API_KEY is not set`. Scrubbed explicitly because the Setup group already sourced .env into this shell.

groups.title: One more thing · where v0 stops

beats.label: Blank a second scratch spec
beats.cue: “The recipe's Telephony-adapters section says a real phone call is a few lines of YAML. Let's hold it to that.”

beats.label: Type the same head and agent
beats.cue: “Identical spec above the voice block — only the transport is going to change.”

beats.label: Type the recipe's Twilio block
beats.cue: “Account SID, auth token, from-number — all as env refs, all straight out of the recipe.”

beats.label: Lint it
beats.cue: “Exit 1: `voice: Unrecognized key(s) in object: 'telephony'`. The voice schema is closed, so a field the runtime does not implement yet is rejected here — in 200 milliseconds, at your desk — instead of on a live call. Treat the recipe's telephony blocks as the roadmap, not the API.”

verify.note: measured exit 1, one parse error: `voice: Unrecognized key(s) in object: 'telephony'`. The recipe documents voice.telephony (Twilio / LiveKit / Vapi) but the v0 spec schema does not accept it — a deliberate rejection beat, and an honest one.

beats.label: Run the live realtime smoke
beats.cue: [needs-key] “The section-24 smoke synthesizes a question with OpenAI TTS, streams it into the daemon, and asserts on the transcript and the returned audio. That is the real end-to-end take.”

verify.note: needs OPENAI_API_KEY; POSTs to /v1/audio/speech for the fixture utterance and opens a live Realtime session. Compiles starters/voice into its own gitignored dist/.
